time_version: SELECT NOW(6) db_now, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) db_utc, @@session.time_zone session_tz, @@system_time_zone system_tz, DATABASE() current_db, TIDB_VERSION() tidb_version
ddl_recent: SELECT JOB_ID,DB_NAME,TABLE_NAME,JOB_TYPE,STATE,CREATE_TIME,START_TIME,END_TIME FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.DDL_JOBS WHERE TABLE_NAME='orders_big' ORDER BY JOB_ID DESC LIMIT 20
stats_meta: SHOW STATS_META WHERE Db_name='squad_lab' AND Table_name='orders_big'
stats_health: SHOW STATS_HEALTHY WHERE Db_name='squad_lab' AND Table_name='orders_big'
stats_histograms: SHOW STATS_HISTOGRAMS WHERE Db_name='squad_lab' AND Table_name='orders_big'
